name: Style Shepherd Agent
description: A demo agent that helps generate and apply visual styles, produce frontend mock data, create image style-transfer presets, and provide design-system guidance for web UIs and pitch slides.

apiKeyHeader.name: x-api-key
apiKeyHeader.description: Simple API key in header for demo / test usage

skills.name: Style Guide Generator
skills.description: Generates design tokens, color palettes, typography, and component style guidelines from a short natural-language brief or an uploaded brand image.
examples: Generate a light/dark design token set for a fintech dashboard aimed at professionals.
{"prompt": "Create a minimal, high-contrast color palette for an educational app", "preferences": {"accent": "blue"}}

skills.name: Frontend Mock Data
skills.description: Produces realistic mock JSON for frontend UIs (cards, tables, agent lists, invoices) and can return Cursor/Storybook-ready fixtures.
examples: Produce 10 AgentCard-style mock objects for an agent directory with avatars and sample capabilities.

skills.name: Image Style Transfer / Edit
skills.description: Applies stylistic transformations (film, cinematic, monochrome diagrammatic) to uploaded images or synthesizes style previews.
examples: Create a monochrome, diagram-style slide background from this hero photo.

skills.name: UX Micro-Consultant
skills.description: Provides short, actionable UI/UX recommendations and copy suggestions for product screens or marketing slides.
examples: Review this hero section and suggest three headline alternatives optimized for click-through.
